title: Add an on-hold order status that orders, shipping and invoicing all handle
prompt:
This shop app has three features that depend on the order status exported by orders/index.ts: orders (order values and status changes), shipping (what is sent to the carrier, and the daily summary line) and invoicing (statement lines and the amount due). Add a new order status 'on-hold' (an order parked for a reason, for example a fraud check) and make each feature handle it as described below. The other two features must keep using the OrderStatus that orders exports; do not copy it.

orders: OrderStatus gains 'on-hold'. An order on hold carries holdReason: string; every other order has no holdReason. orders/index.ts exports two new functions, placeOnHold(order, reason: string) and releaseFromHold(order), which return the same kind of result transition returns: { kind: 'moved', order } on success and { kind: 'rejected', from, to } when the order's status does not allow the move. Only a paid order can be placed on hold (to is 'on-hold'); only an on-hold order can be released (to is 'paid'), and the released order is a plain paid order with no holdReason. The reason is stored trimmed. A blank reason (empty or only whitespace) returns { kind: 'blank-reason' } instead, but only after the status check passed (holding a pending order with a blank reason is a plain rejection). transition never moves an order to or from 'on-hold': it returns its usual rejected result for those. statusLabel('on-hold') is 'On hold'.

shipping: on-hold orders are never shipped. selectToShip and shipOrders skip them, like every order that is not paid. summarizeShipping reports held orders as the last item of the line, '<n> on hold', left out when n is 0 (for example 'Shipping summary for 2026-03-31: 2 to ship, 1 waiting for payment, 1 shipped, 2 on hold'). A day with only held orders reads 'Shipping summary for 2026-03-31: 1 on hold'. Every other summary line stays exactly as it is today.

invoicing: statementLine labels an invoice whose orderStatus is 'on-hold' as 'HELD' (for example 'INV-2 [HELD] $19.99'). Held invoices are left out of dueTotalCents, and therefore out of the Due line that printStatement writes. The statement still lists them.

Existing tests must keep passing without being edited. Add tests for all three features in test/on-hold.test.ts. Run nitpicker-gate until it exits 0.
